statement: One error per call of `path` that names a git write verb and passes `-m` or `--message` followed by anything but a literal or an f-string (a name, a call, an attribute: text of unbounded size on the command line).
note: Basis: D-206 (a) decides it: the record passed as a command-line argument is fixed as a class, since every git write of text has the same shape (unit C1); the module head cites C1, D-206 for this rule.
